episodes.summary: Maul seeks to enlighten his new prisoners while Lawson pursues him.

episodes.summary: As Maul's plans come together, Devon considers her options.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: Pride and Vengeance
episodes.summary: A confrontation between Lawson and Maul threatens everyone.

episodes.summary: Captain Lawson faces a sobering new reality.

episodes.summary: Pushed to their breaking point, our heroes have no choice but to run.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: Call to Oblivion
episodes.summary: As enemies close in, Maul is forced to take a stand.

episodes.summary: Trust is tested as newly forged allies navigate the only way out.

episodes.title: Chapter 10: The Dark Lord
episodes.summary: One last test, one last chance to escape and survive.
